correctness.rationale: For W_{n+1}=K1 join C_n, Fourier rim eigenvectors give theta_k=2cos(2pi k/n) with parity (-1)^k at the antipode; rim-uniform/hub 2x2 block has lambda±=1±sqrt(n+1), and all these supported modes must approximate common target phase. For n congruent 2 mod4, opposite-parity paired modes impose incompatible gamma² and -2 phase; for n congruent 4 mod8, the zero eigenmode k=n/4 and -2 mode force a phase contradiction. For 8|n with odd p divisor, root-of-unity zero-sum across k+an/p at odd and even k forces (-gamma)^p=gamma^p=1, impossible. At n=2^r,r>=4, the real cyclotomic basis 1,theta_1,...,theta_{n/4-1} is Q-independent from sqrt(n+1), since the sole real quadratic subfield of the relevant 2-power cyclotomic field is Q(sqrt2) and n+1 is odd nonsquare. Kronecker integer-time approximation t=2pi j produces the phase demands; n=8 reduces to density of j sqrt2 mod1. No perfect transfer: zero mode gives gamma=1, -2 mode gives t=pi j, incompatible with sqrt(n+1) irrational for r>=4 or sqrt2 for r=3. The conclusion is only even n>=4, adjacency, antipodal rim vertices, not all pairs or Laplacian walk.

originality.rationale: Cycle and circulant PGST classification does not include the nonregular wheel (hub changes spectrum), and published join-graph work provides join eigenvalue and perfect-transfer constraints rather than the all-n antipodal wheel PGST iff-power-of-2 criterion. General integral quantum-walk algorithms do not by themselves print or imply a closed wheel classification without the parity/cyclotomic analysis. No exact published wheel table or Resultary equivalent found in the actual searches; this is best-of-knowledge with unindexed literature risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed equivalent PGST-on-wheels or general graph-join result might exist; the negative search does not establish global novelty.
The proof requires adjacency Hamiltonian, even rim order and unweighted join; finite wheel phase experiments cannot prove an infinite sequence.

value.rationale: The wheel is a canonical graph obtained by adjoining one universal hub to a cycle, and the added exceptional irrational frequency makes transfer qualitatively nontrivial. An exact iff classification, explicit approximating discrete times, and PST impossibility separate PGST from PST for a natural infinite graph family, a motivated spectral classification not an arbitrary numerical sample.
